PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-BRCASTECHO.descricao: Network allows the delivery of standard broadcast ICMP Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-BRCASTECHO.correcao: Configure routers and firewalls to drop directed broadcast ICMP Echo Request packets (e.g., 'no ip directed-broadcast').

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-BRCASTECHODEV.descricao: Device responds to standard broadcast ICMP Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-BRCASTECHODEV.correcao: Disable responses to ICMP echo requests sent to broadcast addresses on the OS configuration level.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-DNSSD.descricao: Network allows devices discovery with IPv4 DNS Service Discovery
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-DNSSD.correcao: Restrict multicast/broadcast DNS-SD traffic to authorized subnets or block port 5353 UDP at network switches.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-DNSSDDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 DNS Service Discovery packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-DNSSDDEV.correcao: Disable DNS Service Discovery (mDNS/DNS-SD) services on end-user devices if not required for operation.

PTV-NET-MITM-4-ICMPREDIR.descricao: Network does not block ICMP Redirect messages
PTV-NET-MITM-4-ICMPREDIR.correcao: Configure routers and firewalls to block and prevent routing of ICMP Redirect messages across network segments.

PTV-NET-MITM-4-ICMPREDIRDEV.descricao: Device communication can be redirected using ICMP Redirect
PTV-NET-MITM-4-ICMPREDIRDEV.correcao: Disable acceptance of ICMP Redirects on end-host systems (e.g., set sysctl 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0').

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-INVPACKET.descricao: Network allows the delivery of invalid ICMP packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-INVPACKET.correcao: Deploy network-level intrusion prevention systems (IPS) or firewall rules to drop malformed ICMP packets.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-INVPACKETDEV.descricao: Device responds to invalid ICMP packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-INVPACKETDEV.correcao: Ensure network stack and OS kernel patches are up to date to properly drop invalid ICMP packets without responding.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv4 LLMNR A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR.correcao: Disable LLMNR via Group Policy / system configuration or block UDP port 5355 at the switch/firewall level.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 LLMNR A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNRDEV.correcao: Disable LLMNR on Windows/Linux host settings to prevent local name resolution spoofing.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR-PTR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv4 LLMNR PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR-PTR.correcao: Block LLMNR PTR queries (UDP 5355) across local network segments using firewall/ACL policies.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR-PTRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 LLMNR PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-LLMNR-PTRDEV.correcao: Disable LLMNR client name resolution services on the host system.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv4 MDNS A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS.correcao: Filter mDNS traffic (UDP port 5353 / 224.0.0.251) on network switches if local discovery is not needed.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNSDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 MDNS A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNSDEV.correcao: Disable mDNS responder services (e.g., Avahi daemon / Bonjour) on end-user devices.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS-PTR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv4 MDNS PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS-PTR.correcao: Block IPv4 mDNS PTR query propagation across network segments using switch ACLs.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS-PTRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 MDNS PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-MDNS-PTRDEV.correcao: Disable mDNS service or restrict mDNS responses on host systems.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-MULTIECHO.descricao: Network allows the delivery of standard multicast ICMP Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-MULTIECHO.correcao: Filter or disable ICMP Echo Requests sent to IPv4 multicast addresses at the network interface or host firewall.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-MULTIECHODEV.descricao: Device responds to standard multicast ICMP Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-4-MULTIECHODEV.correcao: Configure host firewalls to ignore ICMP Echo Requests targeted at multicast addresses.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-WS.descricao: Network allows devices discovery with IPv4 WS-Discovery
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-WS.correcao: Disable WS-Discovery multicast traffic (UDP port 3702) across switch VLANs.

PTV-NET-IDENT-4-WSDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv4 WS-Discovery packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-4-WSDEV.correcao: Disable WSD (Web Services for Devices) provider service in Windows / Linux services.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-DNSSD.descricao: Network allows devices discovery with IPv6 DNS Service Discovery
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-DNSSD.correcao: Restrict multicast IPv6 DNS Service Discovery packets at switch and router boundaries.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-DNSSDDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 DNS Service Discovery packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-DNSSDDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 DNS Service Discovery daemon/service on client devices.

PTV-NET-MISCONF-6-RAGUARD.descricao: Network does not have RA guard configured
PTV-NET-MISCONF-6-RAGUARD.correcao: Enable IPv6 RA Guard on managed switch ports to drop unauthorized Router Advertisement messages.

PTV-NET-MITM-6-FAKERADNS.descricao: Network allows a client to be forced to use a fraudulent DNS server through a spoofed RA message
PTV-NET-MITM-6-FAKERADNS.correcao: Deploy IPv6 RA Guard and DHCPv6 Guard on switch infrastructure to block spoofed RA DNS configurations.

PTV-NET-MITM-6-FAKERADNSDEV.descricao: Device connects to a fraudulent DNS server through a spoofed RA message
PTV-NET-MITM-6-FAKERADNSDEV.correcao: Configure client hosts to ignore RDNSS options from untrusted IPv6 Router Advertisements or enforce static/DHCPv6 DNS.

PTV-NET-MITM-6-ICMPREDIR.descricao: Network permits ICMPv6 Redirect messages that steer devices through the attacker
PTV-NET-MITM-6-ICMPREDIR.correcao: Drop ICMPv6 Redirect messages (Type 137) at the network level or switch port security controls.

PTV-NET-MITM-6-ICMPREDIRDEV.descricao: Device can be steered to forward traffic through the attacker via ICMPv6 Redirect
PTV-NET-MITM-6-ICMPREDIRDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 ICMP Redirect processing on hosts (e.g., set sysctl 'net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects=0').

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-FAKERA.descricao: Network allows the delivery of illegitimate RA packets
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-FAKERA.correcao: Enable RA Guard (RFC 6105) on switch access ports to enforce legitimate Router Advertisement sources.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-FAKERADEV.descricao: Device does not ignore the illegitimate RA packets
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-FAKERADEV.correcao: Enable secure IPv6 configuration settings on endpoints to ignore unauthenticated RA messages.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHODO.descricao: Network allows the delivery of invalid Destination Option ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHODO.correcao: Configure network boundaries to drop malformed ICMPv6 packets containing invalid Destination Options headers.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHODODEV.descricao: Device responds to invalid Destination Option ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHODODEV.correcao: Update system kernel to validate IPv6 extension headers and silently drop invalid Destination Option ICMPv6 Echo Requests.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHOHBH.descricao: Network allows the delivery of invalid Hop-by-Hop ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHOHBH.correcao: Drop malformed Hop-by-Hop extension header ICMPv6 packets at the edge firewall or switch ACLs.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHOHBHDEV.descricao: Device responds to invalid Hop-by-Hop ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVECHOHBHDEV.correcao: Update the host OS network stack to validate Hop-by-Hop headers and reject malformed ICMPv6 Echo Requests.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVPACKET.descricao: Network allows the delivery of invalid ICMPv6 packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVPACKET.correcao: Filter malformed ICMPv6 traffic at network switches and firewalls using ACLs or IPS policies.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVPACKETDEV.descricao: Device responds to invalid ICMPv6 packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-INVPACKETDEV.correcao: Apply vendor security updates to the OS kernel to correctly handle malformed ICMPv6 packets.

PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYHBH.descricao: Network allows the delivery of empty packets with invalid Hop-by-Hop Options Header
PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYHBH.correcao: Enforce strict IPv6 extension header validation on routers and network security appliances.

PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYHBHDEV.descricao: Device responds to empty packets with invalid Hop-by-Hop Options Header
PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYHBHDEV.correcao: Update OS network stack patches to discard empty IPv6 packets with invalid Hop-by-Hop options.

PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYDO.descricao: Network allows the delivery of empty packets with invalid Destination Options Header
PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYDO.correcao: Filter invalid IPv6 packets with malformed Destination Options at network ingress boundaries.

PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYDODEV.descricao: Device responds to empty packets with invalid Destination Options Header
PTV-NET-IDENT-IP-6-INVEMPTYDODEV.correcao: Ensure host operating systems validate IPv6 extension header structures and drop malformed packets.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv6 LLMNR A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR.correcao: Block IPv6 LLMNR traffic (UDP port 5355 / multicast ff02::1:3) at network switches.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 LLMNR A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNRDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 LLMNR protocol resolution on host operating systems.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR-PTR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv6 LLMNR PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR-PTR.correcao: Filter IPv6 LLMNR reverse lookups (PTR queries) on local switches and firewalls.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR-PTRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 LLMNR PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-LLMNR-PTRDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 LLMNR service on the host device.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv6 MDNS A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS.correcao: Block multicast IPv6 mDNS packets (UDP port 5353 / ff02::fb) at switch port levels.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNSDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 MDNS A, AAAA or ANY packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNSDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 mDNS services on individual host devices.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS-PTR.descricao: Network allows the delivery of IPv6 MDNS PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS-PTR.correcao: Filter IPv6 mDNS PTR request packets using switch-level access control lists.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS-PTRDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 MDNS PTR packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-MDNS-PTRDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 mDNS service daemons on local endpoints.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV1.descricao: Network allows the delivery of illegitimate MLDv1 queries
PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV1.correcao: Configure switch-level MLD Snooping and filtering to block unauthorized MLDv1 queries.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV1DEV.descricao: Device responds to illegitimate MLDv1 queries
PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV1DEV.correcao: Configure host network stack to ignore untrusted or illegitimate MLDv1 queries.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD1GLIP.descricao: Network allows the delivery of MLDv1 messages from a global address
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD1GLIP.correcao: Block MLDv1 messages originating from global unicast IPv6 addresses using switch ACLs.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD1GLIPDEV.descricao: Device responds to MLDv1 messages from a global address
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD1GLIPDEV.correcao: Configure host IPv6 stack to drop MLDv1 messages not originating from link-local addresses.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV2.descricao: Network allows the delivery of illegitimate MLDv2 queries
PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV2.correcao: Implement MLD Snooping and MLD query inspection on network switches to drop illegitimate MLDv2 queries.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV2DEV.descricao: Device responds to illegitimate MLDv2 queries
PTV-NET-IDENT-ACTIVE-6-MLDV2DEV.correcao: Configure host firewall to filter unauthorized MLDv2 query messages.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD2GLIP.descricao: Network allows the delivery of MLDv2 messages from a global address
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD2GLIP.correcao: Filter MLDv2 traffic originating from global IPv6 addresses at the switch level.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD2GLIPDEV.descricao: Device responds to MLDv2 messages from a global address
PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-6-MLD2GLIPDEV.correcao: Configure endpoints to drop MLDv2 messages sent from global IPv6 source addresses.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-MULTIECHO.descricao: Network allows the delivery of standard multicast ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-MULTIECHO.correcao: Restrict or filter IPv6 multicast ICMPv6 Echo Requests using router/firewall access control lists.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-MULTIECHODEV.descricao: Device responds to standard multicast ICMPv6 Echo Request
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-MULTIECHODEV.correcao: Configure host firewall rules (e.g., ip6tables / nftables) to ignore multicast ICMPv6 Echo Requests.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-OUTRANGE.descricao: Network allows valid or invalid ICMPv6 packets to be delivered from sources outside the scanned local network range
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-OUTRANGE.correcao: Implement ingress filtering (BCP 38) on network boundaries to block packets originating outside the local subnet range.

PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-OUTRANGEDEV.descricao: Device responds to valid or invalid ICMPv6 packets from sources outside the scanned local network range
PTV-NET-IDENT-ICMP-6-OUTRANGEDEV.correcao: Configure host firewall to only accept ICMPv6 control messages from expected local network sources.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-PREDICT-GLOBIP.descricao: Device uses predictable IPv6 global address
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-PREDICT-GLOBIP.correcao: Enable IPv6 Privacy Extensions (RFC 4941 / RFC 8981) to generate randomized global IPv6 addresses.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-PREDICT-LINKLOCALIP.descricao: Device uses predictable IPv6 link-local address
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-PREDICT-LINKLOCALIP.correcao: Enable RFC 7217 (opaque / stable privacy link-local addresses) instead of EUI-64 MAC-derived addresses.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-WS.descricao: Network allows devices discovery with IPv6 WS-Discovery
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-WS.correcao: Filter IPv6 WS-Discovery traffic (UDP 3702 / ff02::c) at the switch port level.

PTV-NET-IDENT-6-WSDEV.descricao: Device responds to IPv6 WS-Discovery packets
PTV-NET-IDENT-6-WSDEV.correcao: Disable IPv6 Web Services Discovery on host devices.

PTV-NET-NET-MISCONF-8021X.correcao: Deploy 802.1X Network Access Control (NAC) with RADIUS authentication on all managed switch ports.
